subject: general
question: .PNG file is a/an:
solution:
The correct answer is __**image file**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **.PNG** stands for Portable Network Graphics.
 
• It is a raster-graphics file format that supports lossless data compression.
 
• The .PNG file format was created as an improved, non-patented replacement for Graphics Interchange Format (GIF).
 
• PNG files are widely used for web graphics, logos, charts, and illustrations due to their high quality and ability to support transparency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Audio File Formats**

 
 
• Audio file formats are used to store digital audio data on computers and other digital devices.
 
• Common audio file formats include MP3, WAV, and AAC.
 
• These formats vary in terms of compression, quality, and compatibility with different devices and software.
 
 
 
• **Batch Files**
 
 
• A batch file is a script file in DOS, OS/2, and Microsoft Windows.
 
• It consists of a series of commands to be executed by the command-line interpreter.
 
• Batch files have the .BAT or .CMD file extension and are used for automating repetitive tasks.
 
 
 
• **Video File Formats**
 
 
• Video file formats are used to store digital video data on computers and other digital devices.
 
• Common video file formats include MP4, AVI, and MKV.
 
• These formats vary in terms of compression, quality, and compatibility with different devices and software.
 
 
 
• **Image File Formats**
 
 
• Image file formats are used to store digital images on computers and other digital devices.
 
• Common image file formats include JPEG, PNG, and GIF.
 
• These formats vary in terms of compression, quality, and compatibility with different devices and software.
